description: Stop points, prerequisites, and side quest definitions

guidance.watch_for: Rhodey is played by a new actor (his first line winks at it). The new Stark legal employee is a much bigger deal than she seems. Late in the film, check the news monitor at S.H.I.E.L.D., and stay for the post-credits crater.
guidance.watch_instruction: 1 Credit · STOP before credits — the credits scene belongs RIGHT BEFORE Thor

stop_point.instruction: 1 Credit · STOP before credits — the credits scene belongs RIGHT BEFORE Thor

doomsday.connection: Introduces a major new character and expands Tony Stark's world in ways that ripple forward for years.

spoiler.label: Contains spoilers — tap to reveal
spoiler.content: Natasha Romanoff makes her debut here, eventually leading to Yelena and a spot on the Doomsday roster. War Machine officially arrives, and the film ends with a scene that connects directly into Thor.

guidance.watch_for: The agent with the bow in the crane is a future Avenger. 'Magic is just science we don't understand yet' is the load-bearing line for the whole cosmic side. Stay for the glowing cube.
guidance.watch_instruction: 1 Credit · STOP before credits — the credits scene belongs RIGHT BEFORE The Avengers

stop_point.instruction: 1 Credit · STOP before credits — the credits scene belongs RIGHT BEFORE The Avengers

doomsday.connection: Kicks off a character arc for Loki that eventually becomes central to the multiverse storylines, and introduces the cosmic side of the MCU.

spoiler.label: Contains spoilers — tap to reveal
spoiler.content: Loki's path from villain here to his own solo series and later a spot connected to Doomsday effectively starts in this movie. The Tesseract introduced here becomes a key object in Captain America and The Avengers.

guidance.watch_for: The inventor helping Steve is Tony Stark's father. Remember the best friend's name: Bucky. And yes, it ends in the present day.
guidance.watch_instruction: 1 Credit · STOP before credits — the credits scene belongs RIGHT BEFORE The Avengers

stop_point.instruction: 1 Credit · STOP before credits — the credits scene belongs RIGHT BEFORE The Avengers

doomsday.connection: Establishes the super-soldier program's origins and introduces a friendship that has major consequences for the whole saga.

spoiler.label: Contains spoilers — tap to reveal
spoiler.content: This film retroactively explains the science behind The Incredible Hulk's experiment. Bucky's apparent death here is the start of a storyline that continues through Civil War and Thunderbolts, and Peggy Carter's legacy echoes into the What If series.

guidance.watch_for: Lighter on purpose after Infinity War. The mid-credits scene is the entire reason this movie sits here — DO NOT skip the credits.
guidance.watch_instruction: 1 Credit · STOP before credits — the credits scene belongs RIGHT AFTER Infinity War

stop_point.instruction: 1 Credit · STOP before credits — the credits scene belongs RIGHT AFTER Infinity War

doomsday.connection: A lighter film after Infinity War, with a credits scene that connects directly into the aftermath of the Snap.

spoiler.label: Contains spoilers — tap to reveal
spoiler.content: The mid-credits scene shows Scott Lang trapped in the Quantum Realm at the exact moment the Snap happens, stranding him there while his family disappears. That accident becomes a key part of how Endgame's time heist works.

guidance.watch_for: It's 1995. Watch Fury before the eyepatch, note the pager, and don't trust anything you're told about the Skrulls.
guidance.watch_instruction: 1 Credit · STOP before end-credits — post-credit scene belongs after Infinity War

stop_point.instruction: 1 Credit · STOP before end-credits — post-credit scene belongs after Infinity War

doomsday.connection: A 1990s-set origin story that explains a mysterious object seen earlier in the MCU timeline.

spoiler.label: Contains spoilers — tap to reveal
spoiler.content: The pager introduced here is the same one Nick Fury uses in Infinity War's post-credits scene. The reveal about the Skrulls also connects forward into Secret Invasion and The Marvels.

guidance.watch_for: The sitcom formats aren't a gimmick — they're the text. Ask why each era looks the way it does. Two credit scenes, both required.
guidance.watch_instruction: 9 eps · STOP before Ep 9 mid-credit scene — it's a separate entry below

stop_point.instruction: 9 eps · STOP before Ep 9 mid-credit scene — it's a separate entry below

doomsday.connection: Explores Wanda's grief through a sitcom-style format that eventually connects to her next major appearance and to other future shows.

spoiler.label: Contains spoilers — tap to reveal
spoiler.content: Wanda's arc at the end of this season leads directly into Multiverse of Madness. Agatha gets her own spin-off series, and Wanda's son Billy is reportedly part of the storyline VisionQuest picks up. Monica Rambeau's ending here also connects to The Marvels.

guidance.watch_for: Natasha on the run in the gap between Civil War and Infinity War — this film fills that hole. Go in blind on Taskmaster. When the credits roll, mind the stop point below.
guidance.watch_instruction: 1 Credit · STOP before end-credits — post-credit scene belongs right before Hawkeye

stop_point.instruction: 1 Credit · STOP before end-credits — post-credit scene belongs right before Hawkeye

doomsday.connection: Fills in a gap in Natasha's story and introduces two characters who become important later.

spoiler.label: Contains spoilers — tap to reveal
spoiler.content: Yelena, Red Guardian, and Taskmaster all eventually connect to Thunderbolts and the New Avengers. A post-credits scene introduces Valentina for the first time, setting her on a path toward Yelena's storyline in Hawkeye.

source_metadata.status_note: Moved here — the story happens right after Civil War. Introduces Yelena and Red Guardian (both in Doomsday).

side_quests.name: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. Season 1
side_quests.watch_order: episodes 1–7, then Thor: The Dark World, then episodes 8–16, then The Winter Soldier, then episodes 17–22

side_quests.name: Luke Cage / Iron Fist / The Defenders / Jessica Jones Seasons 2–3
side_quests.watch_order: weave in by release order; The Defenders needs Luke Cage and Iron Fist Season 1 first

side_quests.name: Raimi and Webb Spider-Man films
side_quests.watch_order: slot right before No Way Home
